lore: Vince finished last in each of the last three seasons.

Vince: Right where the last three seasons left off.

lines: Vince has finished last three seasons running and is −$726 so far this year. The four-peat is on schedule.
Vince isn't a league member. Vince is a recurring donor. Thank you for your continued support.
JD leads the season at +$500 with three Team pots, and that Week 5 Jefferson comes with an asterisk. Champions always have one.
Galli has won the Team pot three times and is still −$352. The Lightning table giveth nothing and taketh everything.
Kevin has had six Lightning picks score zero this season, the most in the league. Saquon's 0 in Week 4 was a team effort.
JohnO has been up in 7 of 9 weeks and leads the league with 14 Lightning column wins. Quietly the most annoying owner in the league.
Art started Lamar Jackson in Week 8 and got 0. Lamar got paid that week. Art did not.
Galli's Drake Maye scored 38 in Week 5, the best Lightning game of the season. Galli's week: +$116. Peak Galli.
Week 9, QB3: Love 36, Stroud 36. Kevin and JD split it, and everyone else paid for both.
Mxue went +$448 in Week 9, then turned in the exact same Team table as Art in Week 10. Plagiarism or genius? The pot will decide.
JohnO is +$588 in Lightning and −$180 in the Team table, with zero pots. Brilliant at the side bets, allergic to the main event.
Galli is +$170 in the Team table and −$522 in Lightning. Somebody please take Galli's Lightning picks away.
Vince has the season's two lowest Team tables: 43 in Week 6, then 52 in Week 7. Back to back. Commitment.
Vince won the Week 2 Team pot with 114, then gave most of it back in Lightning and finished the week +$64. Even Vince's best week needed a refund.
Week 2: Puka Nacua didn't play, and Art, Mxue, Galli and JohnO had all picked Puka. One DNP, four victims.
Galli has picked Bijan Robinson in all nine weeks. That's not a pick, that's a marriage.
Jahmyr Gibbs has been on Art's, Mxue's and Vince's rosters in eight of nine weeks. Original thinking is not this league's strength.
Kevin's Tony Pollard scored 32 in Week 7 and won $290 in a single column, the biggest one-column payday of the season.
Art's Tee Higgins scored 27 in Week 8 and took $266 off the rest of WR2. The rest of WR2 is still in recovery.
Kevin's Sam Darnold scored 0 in Week 1 and cost Kevin $68 in QB4. Season-opening tradition: done.
Through Week 9, Mxue alternated up, down, up, down, every single week. Not a fantasy player, a coin flip.
JohnO was up five weeks in a row (Weeks 4 to 8), the longest streak in the league. The Lightning picks should be drug tested.
JD has been the week's biggest winner three times: Weeks 2, 6 and 8. The rest of the league has started a support group.
Galli has been the week's biggest loser twice and has won three Team pots. Galli contains multitudes.
Vince was the week's biggest loser in Weeks 7 and 9. Consistency is a skill.
Kevin and JohnO have zero Team pots between them this season. The $140 pot doesn't know their names.
Week 9, QB3: every quarterback scored at least 17, except Galli's Malik Willis with 6. That cost Galli $60.
Kevin's Caleb Williams scored 37 in Week 1 and Kevin was the week's biggest winner. Then Week 3 happened, and Kevin was the biggest loser.
